sources.publisher: NIIED (Study in Korea), Ministry of Education of Korea
sources.note: 2026 GKS-G notice (latest graduate call, 2 February 2026): 'University Information (General)' 1 to 3 and '(Specialization)' zip files, one 'Available Departments' Excel file per university with master's and doctoral flags; the source of every graduate department listed

sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Italy, hosting the NIIED document
sources.note: 2026 GKS-G Application Guidelines: Type A (35) and Type B (41) lists, R&D (60 departments, 25 institutions) and Global Network (7 departments, 6 institutions) specialization programmes, 'all academic fields established by the GKS participating universities'

subject_rule: Not limited by subject: the guidelines allow all academic fields set up by the participating universities, but an applicant can only choose a university and department on the 'University Information' lists (evening, short-term, online and distance programmes do not count; no change of field after selection). Undergraduate applicants to science and engineering departments get 5 percent extra points; the UIC programme and the graduate R&D programme are science and engineering only; the graduate Global Network programme is humanities and social sciences, master's only.

notes: Bachelor (2027 GKS-U call), 3149 rows in 80 institutions, read from the 92 Excel files of the 'University Information' zips: 3028 embassy-track departments of the 28 Type A and 42 Type B universities (one row per university and department, 45 exact repeats removed), 20 UIC departments (16 bachelor's and 4 associate-degree, 100 places, taken from the guideline table because it gives quotas), and 101 associate-degree departments of the 9 associate institutions (Busan Institute of Science and Technology, Cheju Halla, Dong-Eui Institute of Technology, Induk, Korea University of Media Arts, Kyung-In Women's, Kyungbok, Kyungnam College of Information and Technology, Yeungnam University College). Associate-degree rows are kept under the bachelor level and marked in the detail; the 100 UIC places are inside this count.

The UIC institution and department pairs follow the guideline table as printed (checked on the rendered page); the first pass had several of them under the wrong university (for example Medical Information Technology belongs to Inje, not Keimyung; Software to Kookmin; Mechanical Engineering Major and Computer Engineering Major to KOREATECH; Statistics/Big Data Science to Sungshin; Environmental Engineering to Yeungnam; Electrical and Mechanical Engineering to Dong-Eui Institute of Technology; Software Convergence to Kyungbok; Mechanical Engineering to Osan). The Pusan National University Excel file also holds an official Korean sheet of the UIC list, which agrees with these pairs but names Ajou's department 'Software' and Daegu's 'Electronic and Electrical Engineering', and the University Information file lists two Daegu departments; the English guideline names are used.

Graduate (2026 GKS-G call, the latest published; the 2027 graduate call is not out): 3887 master's rows and 3605 doctoral rows in 76 institutions, read from the 90 Excel files of the 'University Information (General)' 1 to 3 and '(Specialization)' zips. A department is recorded under a level only where the university marks it with a circle for that level; one row per university, department and campus, with duplicate lines of the same department merged. Of the master's rows, 66 are R&D specialization departments (science and engineering; 25 institutions) and 9 are Global Network departments (humanities and social sciences; 6 institutions).

The R&D and Global Network Excel files hold more lines than the guideline states (66 R&D lines against '60 departments', 9 Global Network lines against '7 departments'); the guideline counts programmes, the files count the concentrations each university lists. All lines of the files are recorded.

23 graduate lines are marked 'X' for both master's and doctorate (Inje and Kyungpook research-only lines, 16 Kangwon Gangneung and Wonju lines, a Kookmin line); they are not degree offerings and are left out. Korea University's International Studies lines are 'Only Embassy Track Available' and are recorded with that remark.

The 2026 guideline lists DGIST (Daegu Gyeongbuk Institute of Science and Technology) as a Type A institution, but the University Information zips hold no file for it, so no DGIST departments are recorded. Seoul Theological University appears only as an R&D institution. Baekseok University has one department line.

Each undergraduate line states the Type A or Type B group, degree length, field group, language of teaching and campus as the file gives them. Language of teaching is mostly Korean 100 percent (a Korean-language year comes first); English-taught departments carry 'English 100%' or a mixed value.

Sunchon National University's undergraduate sheet lists whole schools with their majors in one cell; these are split into one row per major with the school in brackets. Pukyong National University's file lists six departments that can be chosen from the second year; they are recorded with that remark.

Counts here do not match any figure the guidelines state, because the guidelines give no total number of departments; they state only quotas and numbers of institutions, which were matched: Type A 28 and Type B 42 (undergraduate); 35 Type A and 41 Type B (graduate).
